The '''DE-10 blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that saw use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its heaviest users in the period were members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group based on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] infiltrated the [[Death Watch bunker]], their main base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] discovered a schematic for the weapon along with specialized barrels used in its construction. The spacer eventually had one of the [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]] created for personal use.

==Description==
The DE-10 [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] fired distinctive [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolts, and its hefty weight gave it the feeling of a formidable weapon in trained [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. The majority of the weapon's body was a silver-gray color with a black grip. It had a maximum range of sixty-five [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
The DE-10 was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol that saw use in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used heavily by members of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group that was, at the [[Time/Legends|time]], stationed on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Members of the group within their main base on Endor, the [[Death Watch bunker]], often carried schematics of the DE-10 and various parts used in its construction.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] infiltrated the bunker and found the blaster pistol's schematics and specialized parts. The spacer eventually had one of the weapons constructed for personal use.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

Also around the same time, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[OR-5]], a member of the [[HK-series assassin droid]] [[HK-47]]'s [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], owned a variation of the weapon known as "[[OR-5's DE-10]]."<ref name="SWGTrials" />

==Behind the scenes==
The DE-10 blaster pistol appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. The weapon requires a player of the Munitions Trader profession to craft. The player must learn the looted schematic before he or she is able to craft it, and may only craft one before needing another schematic. The DE-10 requires special gun barrels looted from enemies within the Death Watch bunker. Although the player may choose whether or not to craft one of the weapons, this article assumes such a path as representative of full game completion. While ''Galaxies'' places no restrictions on which professions may use the DE-10, OR-5's version is restricted to the [[Spy/Legends|Spy]] profession. The DE-10 blaster pistol was mentioned in two strategy guides released for the game in [[2005]]&mdash;''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]'', both of which list the DE-10 in an index of the various weapons available to players and provide the weapon's general statistics.
